primary_sources.title: No Prompt Left Behind: Exploiting Zero-Variance Prompts in LLM Reinforcement Learning via Entropy-Guided Advantage Shaping
primary_sources.code_status: Official project inspected; executable official code link not found there, not code-verified.
primary_sources.mechanism_zh: 对二值全对/全错组赋正/负方向，再用token词表熵调幅；在Qwen3两规模数学任务有实证。
primary_sources.transfer_zh: 支持区分有用的同分反馈与被忽略指标，但连续动作没有对应的词表熵。固定SDE方差的熵主要由采样协议决定，不能照抄成pose熵；不把人工非零A等同新增安全方向。

primary_sources.title: NGRPO: Negative-enhanced Group Relative Policy Optimization
primary_sources.mechanism_zh: 用虚拟最高分样本校准全错组优势，并配不对称clip；作者报告Qwen2.5-Math-7B数学收益。
primary_sources.transfer_zh: 虚拟正样本没有本场景的真实安全轨迹。全失败统一负A可改变有限样本更新，但不能识别往哪走才安全；安全驾驶不优先用虚构见证替代canonical可评分证据。
primary_sources.official_code_verified: core_algos.py lines156-199 append virtual max_reward1.0 before computing mean/std; pinned source files cached in paper_sources/SAFETY_ZERO_CREDIT_20261031 with SHA receipts.

primary_sources.title: DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale
primary_sources.code_status: Pinned official README inspected; it points to an old verl branch now absent. No claim current README is full dynamic-sampling implementation.
primary_sources.mechanism_zh: 过采样并过滤全0/全1组，凑足有对比梯度的prompt批；论文给出组合和阶段消融。
primary_sources.transfer_zh: 过滤提高有效组密度但并不教会被排除的失败场景；我们零PG111组里96组有真实Comfort差异，直接丢弃会错失现成信号。额外rollout成本必须计入，不能只比optimizer更新。

primary_sources.title: ExGRPO: Learning to Reason from Experience
primary_sources.mechanism_zh: 存已验证成功经验、按难度选题、低熵选轨迹；一条历史成功与新rollout形成对比，并对历史策略概率作校正；Qwen2.5-Math7B主表数学均值45.3→48.3。
primary_sources.transfer_zh: 借鉴真实见证与排除已全会样本，不能把历史World轨迹混入onpolicyGRPO或把CFMenergy当精确IS。我们可仅改变P1 bank见证筛选，保历史轨迹为单独CFM监督。熵选轨迹与50%混合率不迁移。

primary_sources.title: Flow Matching Policy Gradients
primary_sources.mechanism_zh: 以CFM误差差构造PPO比率代理，训练可与采样器解耦；连续控制与部分观测任务有实验。
primary_sources.transfer_zh: 我们的fpo_training使用fresh endpoint、old行为CFM缓存和perMC普通PPO；无A的组仍无PG。采样器无关不意味着奖励同分凭空可学，且代理不是endpoint精确密度。

primary_sources.title: Flow Policy Gradients for Robot Control
primary_sources.mechanism_zh: 机器人操控/运动任务检验perMC CFM比率及稳定性选择；普通PPO与ASPO效果依任务而变。
primary_sources.transfer_zh: 支持我们优先连续flow尺度/时间分布诊断，而不默认迁移LLM token clip。现有Fulltime单因素时间实验已另行推进，本报告不再增一组采样/clip组合。

primary_sources.title: Diffusion Policy Policy Optimization
primary_sources.mechanism_zh: 显式去噪MDP的PG训练与结构化探索，在机器人仿真和实机上验证。
primary_sources.transfer_zh: 探索分布确实重要，但本文不证明我们的末步强噪声有益；既有fixedtheta和LastDet负结果要求将候选质量与学习效果分开。

protocol.safety: if any f: A_safe=f-mean(f); allfail: A_safe=mean(c)-c
protocol.ordering: before Acap5: mixed group with m feasible has every A_raw_feasible-A_raw_unsafe>=1/m>0; unsafe A_raw=-m/8; monotone clamp may tie but cannot invert
protocol.normalization: one population_std of all64 A_raw+1e-8; zero groups included; fixed4inners
protocol.canonical: canonical rewards/records/PDMS/scorer unchanged; never label A_raw as PDMS
protocol.mask: all-zero A_raw group has PGmask0; allfail costtie remains zero
protocol.limitation: metric-conditioned quality credit; not scene-risk inference or safety guarantee
